news.headline: After missing his lone field-goal attempt in Week 8 against the Lions, Reichard bounced back Monday to connect on field
news.detail: After missing his lone field-goal attempt in Week 8 against the Lions, Reichard bounced back Monday to connect on field goals from 43 and 53 yards in the second quarter, which ended up being the only points that the Vikings scored.
